sentences.en: A strong body of 15 destroyers was attached to the Zeebrugge force under Capt.

sentences.en: With them were 33 motor launches under Capt.

sentences.en: This and other points on the route were marked by buoys laid after careful triangulation by Capt.

sentences.en: Bryan Adams ran out along them, followed closely by the Royal Marines led by Capt.
